links.outcome: Response stability across days and within-day time points for repeated LLM queries
links.effect: Day and within-day time point were not significantly associated with accuracy, supporting short-term response stability.
links.quote: Day and within-day time point were not significantly associated with accuracy, supporting short-term response stability.

unlisted_practices: Professional-role prompting effect on LLM guideline concordance
Decision-level error directionality analysis (false-positive vs false-negative) for LLM guideline responses

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM concordance with clinical guidelines and tests the effect of a specific prompt design practice (role-prompting vs non-prompted) on model accuracy and error directionality.
